goals.description: Transfer the chickpeas onto a baking tray
goals.segment_summary: Recipe step S03: Place the chickpeas on a baking sheet and drizzle with the olive oil. Toss to coat, then sprinkle with the paprika, garlic powder, oregano, salt and pepper.
